meta.title: A stage of one event cannot seed a stage in another event
gaps: The case requires two independent events and a pricing trade from one event paired with the event group of another; setup recipes create only one fresh record.
No operation or allowed request route expresses POST /v1/trade/{{pricingTradeUuid}}/add_new_stage_in_live_event.
The expected error code 2000 is not available in the known assertion vocabulary.
